summary: Held the entire episode -- the entry direction was correct from bar 0 onward and px never came close to breakeven, running from +0 to a peak of roughly +176pts before settling in the +80-95pts range by the window's end. There were a few sizable giveback spikes (up to ~70% of a local leg's amplitude) with against-fires (HA/PROPP/CLIMAX) clustering around t=8-9m and t=19-24m, but each time price stabilized well above zero and often made new highs afterward, so none of it read as a genuine wrong-direction reversal -- just normal pullback/consolidation inside a strongly winning short. Next time I'd watch for against-fires clustering AND giveback pushing price toward/through zero (not just retracing a fraction of an already-large favorable move) as the real wrong-direction signature.
